title: OpenRouter DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 incident01 blinded evidence-variant pilot
research_question: How do three blinded evidence variants affect DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 reasoning and broker-mediated response requests for incident01 across four instruction profiles relative to a contemporaneous control?
hypothesis: Evidence manipulation and instruction framing may affect model reasoning and requested actions, while CyberBroker will prevent every policy-denied effect.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: Sixteen-cell OpenRouter pilot pinned to Relace with fallback disabled after a successful native strict-tool preflight. The provider-facing final-report schema omits uniqueItems while the unchanged local assessment validator enforces the complete schema. Response actions remain exclusively broker-mediated. Evaluator-only mappings are excluded and every attempt is retained.
